title: Appendages on Type I and II construction.
officialText:
Appendages on buildings of Type I or II construction shall be constructed
of noncombustible materials. However, on buildings not more than three stories or 40 feet (12 192 mm) in height, whichever is
less, fire-retardant-treated wood shall be permitted.
